issues.concern: The headword 'キャスター' has two distinct meanings, one of which is 'caster (wheel)', which is not an 'occupation'. The current tag 'occupation' only applies to the 'newscaster' meaning.
issues.suggestion: Add 'tool' or 'furniture' to the semantic tags to cover the 'caster (wheel)' meaning. 'tool' is more general and fits better.
